description: Calorie and macro calculator from a real personal trainer's rules (MTFIT): daily calories, protein, carbs and fat for fat loss / weight loss, recomp or muscle gain, with example meals and safe limits (calorie floors, capped deficits). No workout plan: use build_program for that. Metric or US units. Text plus structured JSON. Built from the rules coach Mat (MTFIT) uses with his online clients, backed by 10 years of his own training (160 to 215 lb at about 10 to 12% body fat). For adults 18+. Not medical or dietary advice. Terms: https://mtfit-mcp.mtfit-mcp.workers.dev/terms

age.description: Age in years. Required. Under 18 gets no program.

experience.description: Lifting experience, for the muscle gain surplus. Default intermediate.

food_likes.description: Foods the person likes, comma separated. Include 'vegetarian' or 'vegan' if that applies.

height_cm.description: Height in centimetres. Needed for nutrition targets. Or send height_ft and height_in.

height_ft.description: Height, feet part (US units). Use with height_in.

height_in.description: Height, inches part (with height_ft), or total height in inches if height_ft is not sent.

medical_conditions.description: Pregnancy, heart condition or any other medical condition. Triggers the conservative plan.

weight_kg.description: Body weight in kilograms. Needed for nutrition targets. Or send weight_lb.

name: calculate_macros
